title.narrative: I.R.3.1. 21 Contracting Parties to the Barcelona Convention decided to strengthen the regional policy framework for green and circular businesses in the Mediterranean;

description.narrative: I.R.3.1. 21 Contracting Parties to the Barcelona Convention decided to strengthen the regional policy framework for green and circular businesses in the Mediterranean;

comment.narrative: Contracting Parties
Contracting Parties

21 Contracting Parties to the Barcelona Convention strengthened the regional policy framework for green and circular businesses in the Mediterranean with Decision IG. 2413 on the Development of a Set of Regional Measures to Support the Development of Green and Circular Businesses and to Strengthen the Demand for more Sustainable Products adopted at the twentyfirst Meeting of the Contracting Parties to the Barcelona Convention COP21 held in Naples in December 2019.

comment.narrative: SCP trends overview for the region
SCP trends overview for the region

25 SCP indicators were analysed and integrated within the MapX tool of the World Environment Situation Room WESR. The results were presented at the twentythird and twentyfourth Steering Committee Meetings of the Mediterranean Commission for Sustainable Development June and December 2022. The indicators were connected with the Switchers Monitoring Evaluation Accountability and Learning MEAL system.

title.narrative: I.R.4.1. At least 6 enabling national policies/national initiatives (laws, bylaws)

description.narrative: I.R.4.1. At least 6 enabling national policies/national initiatives (laws, bylaws)

comment.narrative: policies national initiatives in Egypt Israel and Jordan on plastic reduction and waste management initiated
national policiesnational initiatives approved by national governments

No enabling national policynational initiative has yet been approved. However ten initiatives are ongoing including six new ones during the reporting period12. In Egypt the execution of the Waste Management Law remains of actuality. After signing a legal agreement to support its execution in 2022 Egypt will now support 1 a report on Key Performance Indicators and 2 guidelines for selected hazardous waste3. Egypt will also support a preliminary report on the financial mechanism for single use plastic bags4. In Israel a report on circular procurement was prepared and56. In Morocco and Tunisia two circular economy laws one per country are under drafting.Also in Egypt an action plan for the National Blue Economy Strategy remains under drafting counted in the previous reporting period.In Israel the Ministry of Environment will continue to update and validate the National Strategy on Circular Economy in the plastics sector in Hebrew counted in the previous reporting period.

comment.narrative: A cumulative number of 791.5 tons of waste are to be valorized as of late 2022. 600 tons of polypropylene waste will be avoided in Israel thanks to the partnership between KETER and NEGEV Ecology. The Nudie Jeans pilot Tunisia has so far avoided 24 tons of waste. The OTBDIESEL pilot will avoid 7.5 tons of waste while the EVLOX pilot will avoid 160 tons including 50 tons of pure cotton.

comment.narrative: In 2023 232980000 of new investments were promotedo In Egypt up to 200 million of investment into a chemical recycling plant and up to 30 million of investment into mechanical recycling lines were promoted at the investment promotion workshop. Moreover 2.5 million of investment into a recycled yarn spinning line was promoted for one company ZamZam. In Israel 130000 of investment into new polyolefin sleeving lines was promoted for 10 companies.o In Tunisia 350000 of investment into the modernisation of a nonwoven recycling and a nonwoven production line was promoted for one company SOTRAFIB.Worth noting is that two Egyptian companies invested respectively 730500 into a recycled yarn spinning line Perfect Spinning and 700000 into a shredding line ZamZam without direct project support not counted under this indicator.Moreover in Israel a bottletobottle prefeasibility study was conducted with a CAPEX of 15377000. Two PET Bottle to bottle plants were commissioned in Israel in the last 2 years shortly after the prefeasibility study but without direct project support not counted under this indicator.

comment.narrative: Projected source of verification monitoring and reporting systemperiodic reports for the EUfunded intervention. NB the indicator baseline assumes the start of the intervention takes place at the start of the present interventions financing period in 22 prioritized municipalities with a household as an estimated target for measurement unit. Technical cooperation provided by the IP within the intervention framework casts this indicator as Vivienda Saludable strategy which can also target national or central level entities involved in policy formulation and decisionmaking. Limitations To comply with the OPSYS pilot exercise data entered correspond to estimated baseline status as per EU Delegation instructions. Data subject to change including data disaggregation upon completion of the ROM expert mission in June 2022. Additionally the intervention is operating amidst COVID19 operational restrictions and a preelectoral policy national environment. No personalized indicators have been created in the platform at this pilot stage as per training instructions and guidance materials.

comment.narrative: methodology reports of interviews or workshops with at least 20 stakeholders and gender data included

Three national SCP roundtables took place in 2023 including the first roundtable on plastics reduction in Egypt. National SCP roundtables are planned in each country and will continue in 2024.As a reminder the roundtables were postponed due to the COVID19 pandemic.
